answer: Written in a concise bullet points, data-driven conclusions register, it stays short. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the sparrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on recursive zk-SNARKs for scalable verification.
